## IInvoiceBlock type

Invoice block configuration for Telegram payments.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IInvoiceBlock = {
    title: string;
    description: string;
    payload: string;
    currency: string;
    prices: Array<{
        label: string;
        amount: number;
    }>;
};
```

## Remarks

Declared with `<g-invoice>` blocks. The title, description, payload, and price labels support the same `{{var|filter}}` interpolation pipeline as poll questions; the compiled strings are length-checked at runtime before any API call (title 1–32 chars, description 1–255 chars, payload 1–128 bytes per the Bot API `sendInvoice` limits). `currency` is a 3-letter code (`XTR` for Telegram Stars, otherwise an ISO 4217 fiat code). `prices` holds 1 or more line items with positive integer `amount` values in the smallest currency units. Provider tokens are NEVER part of this type — they must come from `renderInvoice` options, never templates.

## Example


```typescript
const stars: IInvoiceBlock = {
  title: `VIP 30 hari`,
  description: `Akses semua konten`,
  payload: `order-1`,
  currency: `XTR`,
  prices: [{label: `VIP 30 hari`, amount: 100}]
}
```
